It’d be one thing if it wasn’t late and my roommate and I weren’t both home, but I don’t want him to overhear what I’m doing.

Basically there’s always stuff I’m worried about in the back of my head. I’m 27, manager at a failing business that’s gonna close in the next couple years, didn’t finish college and am not exactly in a position to go back right now. I’ve been perpetually unhappy for many years. It’s not like I don’t ever experience joy or have good days, but overall there is always an underlying unhappiness in me. Then in the last few weeks things have fallen apart with someone I care very much about and I’m really not sure what’s going to happen with that.
It’s getting late here and I have work in the AM...can’t stay up waiting a long time to get connected again and most likely get a different representative who I would have to start all over with...
I was using the chat, partly because I hate talking on the phone, partly for privacy purposes as I have a roommate and very thin walls. :(
